skins.name: A Gallant Dream
skins.code: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/A Gallant Dream
skins.description: Bestial pattern on robe of white, silver plate on black of gown, adorned with jade, an ensemble unfettered. The gongs of the border's night watch ring out, while Ling seeks the great Dao in woven dream.

skins.name: Half-sweet Strawberry
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Half-sweet Strawberry
skins.description: Outfit Grace wears while making holiday-appropriate sweets. A simple apron meets a clash of bold black against daring red, proof that there is no contradiction between reserved expression and sincere intent.

skins.name: An Opera of Flowers
skins.description: Costume Philae wore while taking part in a traditional Yanese opera. A pale pink robe boasts sleeves of pure white, drawing in even graceful butterflies, who flutter about and rest by her side.

skins.name: By the Lamplight
skins.description: Clothes Surfer wore while sightseeing during the lantern display. A dignified, elegant jacket is draped over an avant-garde red silk top, just like the wearer's cautious exterior hides a daring heart.

skins.name: Clear Morning View
skins.description: Clothes Yu wears when getting ingredients for the reunion dinner. The gold-embroidered top under his cyan jacket billows in the wind. Amidst verdant green, the young man begins his return to his dream of a family gathering.

skins.name: Hazy Jade
skins.code: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Hazy Jade
skins.description: The painter of a thousand forms, wrapped in jade silk. The soul who sculpts ink into shape, entwined in kohl silk. The gauze stretches out before her, serving as her infinite canvas.

skins.name: Ribbons of Promise
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Ribbons of Promise
skins.description: Dress Beanstalk wore to the holiday party. A trailing dress of pure white is punctuated by a beautiful red, the fluttering ribbons highlighting the girl's vibrant charm.
